basis: Creative Authority Pack route lessons and fighter identity contracts. Proposed adaptations are not new canon.

ember-vale.rationale: Nix can make force meet deliberate containment; Ember must learn warmth without domination.
Rook exposes the collateral cost of overwhelming pressure against a person who will not yield.
Kaia can redirect pressure and make Ember confront the difference between leadership and control.

rook-ironside.rationale: Juno challenges protection that denies another person agency.
Ember tests whether Rook can protect while acting, rather than immobilizing everyone around him.
Kaia offers an active balance against Rook taking every burden onto himself.

juno-spark.rationale: Deliberate structure confronts speed without direction.
Rook makes Juno face what remains behind when speed outruns responsibility.
Vector discipline can confront impulsive motion without condemning freedom itself.

nix-calder.rationale: Living improvisation challenges containment that has become control.
Kaia demonstrates structure that can flex rather than freeze.
Ambiguity challenges Nix treating certainty as safety.

orion-vell.rationale: A protector refuses to let people become variables in a correct plan.
Kaia tests a model that cannot account for feelings and consent.
Unpredictable living choice exposes the limits of perfect vector control.

vesper-nyx.rationale: Direct empathy challenges safety through concealment.
Ember can make evasion confront honest emotional exposure.
Prediction can defeat misdirection while leaving Vesper to choose trust rather than deeper concealment.
